question: Sarayu river is a tributary of which river?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Sharda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarayu River**:

 
 
• The Sarayu is the **largest tributary** of the** Sharda River**.
 
• Sarayu originated from** Surmool **and joined** Mahakali at Pancheshwar** which is at the border of **Nepal**.
 
• Sarayu flows through the cities of** Kapkot, Bageshwar and Seraghat** in the state of Uttarakhand. 
 
• The famous city of** Ayodhya** in Uttar Pradesh is situated on the bank of the Sarayu river.
 
• **Bhuni, Sup, and Khati** are some of the famous ghats **on this river's bank** river.
 
• The river forms the south-eastern border between the districts of **Pithoragarh** and** Almora**.
 
• **Temperate and sub-Tropical forests** cover the entire catchment area of the Sarayu River.
 
• ** Ramganga **meets the left side of the Sarayu at** Rameshwar**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pindar River**:

 
 
• Pindar originates from** Pindari Glacier** which is located in** the Bageshwar district of the Kumaon** region in Uttarakhand.
 
• The source of this river, the Pindar glacier is located at an altitude of **3,820 m (12,530 ft)**.
 
• The length of the Pindar river is **105 km**.
 
• **The mouth **of the Pindar river is located at **Karnaprayag **where it ends by its confluence with the **Alaknanda River**.
 
• The river crosses some small villages like **Bagholi, Naryanbagar, Nauligaon, Kulsari and Nauti**.
 
 
 
• **Bhagirathi**: 
 
 
• Bhagirathi is considered the** source stream of the Ganges**.
 
• The source Bhagirathi River is at** Gaumukh** at the foot of the **Gangotri glacier**.
 
• The** Bhagirathi** and **Alaknanda** join at **Devprayag** in Garhwal and are thereafter known as the Ganges.
 
 
 
• **Tons**:
 
 
• The Tons river is a** tributary of the Yamuna** and flows through** the Garhwal **region in** Uttarakhand**, touching Himachal Pradesh.
 
• The source of this river is** Bandarpuch Mountain**.
 
• Its source lies in the **20,722 feet (6,316 m)**.
 
• **Pabbar and Asan** rivers are some of the tributaries of the Tons river.
 
 
 
• **Sharda River**:
 
 
• The Sharda River also called the **Kali river** and** Mahakali River** originates at** Kalapan**i in the Himalayas.
 
• It originates from an elevation of** 3,600 m (11,800 ft)** in the** Pithoragarh** district in **Uttarakhand**.
 
• It join**s the Ghaghra River** which is a tributary of the Ganga.
 
• It takes the name Kali River from the union of the two streams at** Gunji **as it flows through the hills.
 
• After crossing **Brahmadev Mandi near Tanakpur**, it enters the** Terai plains**, where it is called the **Sharda River**.
